name: natl
description: End-to-end testing for web and mobile apps. Write steps in plain English; the agent drives the app. Record once, replay without a model call.

scripts.e2e:web: node examples/web/server.mjs & PID=$!; sleep 1; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$(pwd)/.browsers node bin/natl.js run examples/web/login.test.js; kill $PID 2>/dev/null
scripts.e2e:web:replay: node examples/web/server.mjs & PID=$!; sleep 1; PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$(pwd)/.browsers node bin/natl.js run examples/web/login.test.js --mode replay; kill $PID 2>/dev/null
